notes: A plain allowlist, deliberately separate from institution-registry.json. Purpose: suppress URL-08 ('asks you to verify/log in/pay through a link that is not an official [Mauritius institution] domain') for well-known, long-standing services that legitimately ask users to click their own links every day - being asked to 'verify your account' via a link to paypal.com or google.com is not itself suspicious the way it is for an unrecognized domain. A domain here gets NO impersonation/lookalike protection (URL-01..04 / ID-01 / ID-02 do not consult this file at all, and never will via isTrustedDomain()) - it only ever removes one specific, low-severity false-positive source. Safety principle: because a WRONG entry here would suppress a real warning rather than merely annoy someone, only add a domain you are confident is correct and currently operated by the org it claims to be - when in doubt, leave it out; a missed suppression only costs one extra (still accurate) URL-08 flag, but a wrong entry could hide a real scam. The 'mauritius' list is intentionally short: each entry should get the same before-demo verification pass as data/institution-registry.json before being relied on live. The 'global' list is longer because these are among the most widely-recognized domains on the internet, but they were still not individually re-checked against a live fetch in the same way institution-registry.json's stricter workflow calls for - remove anything that turns out to be wrong or dead. Do not add adult, gambling, or otherwise unvetted domains here, and do not bulk-import from an unreviewed external list - every entry should be one a human can vouch for by name.

user_content_hosts._note: Hosts under a trusted domain where ANYONE can publish a page, form or file. They are never trusted, even though their parent domain is: a phishing page on docs.google.com or forms.office.com is still phishing. Matched as the host itself or any subdomain of it.
